第12章仿佛看到了彭于晏
新书期数据很重要，看书的朋友记得收藏一下，最好还有推荐票，谢谢，谢谢。
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
华十二打算先提取第一项奖励，也就是那24万美刀，不过就在他要选择提取的时候，忽然停住了，因为他要确认，这奖励会以什么形式发放。
如果直接给他钱的话，病房里忽然多出24万美刀，他怎么解释？
如果是一百一张的美刀，那还好些，24沓他还能想办法隐藏，可若是这系统坑爹，弄出24万美刀的钢镚，那他就得哭死。
在脑海中呼叫系统，寻问奖励的发放形式。
还好，系统回复他，金钱奖励可以自由选择，也就是说既可以领现金，也可以通过系统直接打入他的银行账户。
而且系统还告诉华十二，通过系统转入的大额资金，都会下意识的被人忽略，也就是说这些钱在别人眼中都是合法的，不会有任何人怀疑这些钱的合法性。
更贴心的是，系统还可以选择币种，也就是可以直接帮他把美刀按照当前汇率兑换成rmb在打入他的账户中。
华十二听完不由得觉得系统还是挺人性化的，这一系列操作，免去了他不少麻烦。
这种情况下，他当然是选择打入账户了，傻子才会弄那么多现金出来，到时候还不得去存，不够麻烦的呢。
就在他再次要选择提取的时候，华十二又停了下来，寻问道：
“系统，这些钱可以留着在任务世界提取么？”
系统的回答是不行，在任务世界抽取的物品奖励，只能在现实世界提取，但抽取的能力可以在任务世界使用。
那这就没什么好说的了，华十二直接选择了提取第一项奖励，也就是提取那24万美刀，不过他要美刀没什么用，让系统直接帮他兑换成rmb。
他这边刚选择提取，那已经碎屏的手机就同步响起了短信提示音，蛛网状的碎屏勉强能看到信息，信息显示他的银行账户到账了一百五十二万六千零四十。
“耶！”
华十二也没考虑汇率到底对不对什么的，兴奋的挥了挥拳头，虽然有王力两口子感谢那五十万，但这一百五十多万才是他自己赚来的，感觉自然不同。
接下来就是激动人心的时刻了，华十二深吸了两口气，打算提取大奖，也就是巅峰大鲨鱼的力量。

可正当他要提取奖励的时候，系统却发来一道信息：
“由于提取此项奖励的提取时间约为二十分钟，所以建议宿主在安全的环境下提取此项奖励！”
华十二一怔：“为什么要那么长时间，会有什么危险吗？”
系统再次发来一道信息，让他瞬间明白了其中原因。
原来问题出自他的身体上，以他此时的身体状况，根本无法承受巅峰沙克的力量，所以在提取的时候，他的身体会随之发生变化，从而适应这股强大的力量。
华十二吓了一跳，连忙问道：“不会把我变成沙克的那种体型吧？”
系统并没有回答他这个问题，俨然一副爱要不要的样子。
华十二琢磨了半天，不管怎样，先离开医院再说。

Hua Twelve planned to withdraw the first reward first, which was the US$240,000. However, just when he was about to choose to withdraw, he suddenly stopped because he wanted to confirm in what form the reward would be distributed.
If you give him money directly, there is suddenly an extra $240,000 in the ward. How can he explain it?
If it was a hundred-dollar knives, that would be better. He could still find a way to hide the 24 stacks, but if the system cheated him and produced 240,000-dollar steel knives, then he would cry to death.
Call the system in your mind and ask about the form of reward distribution.
Fortunately, the system replied to him that he could freely choose the monetary reward, which meant that he could receive cash or directly deposit it into his bank account through the system.
Moreover, the system also told Hua Twelve that large amounts of funds transferred through the system would be subconsciously ignored by others, which meant that the money was legal in the eyes of others and no one would doubt the legality of the money.
What's more considerate is that the system can also select the currency, which means it can directly help him convert US dollars into RMB according to the current exchange rate and then deposit it into his account.
After listening to this, Hua Twelve couldn't help but feel that the system was quite user-friendly. This series of operations saved him a lot of trouble.
In this case, of course he chose to deposit it into the account. Only a fool would come up with so much cash. It would not be troublesome to save it when the time comes.
Just when he was about to choose extraction again, Hua Twelve stopped again and asked:
"System, can this money be kept and withdrawn in the mission world?"
The system's answer is no. The item rewards extracted in the mission world can only be extracted in the real world, but the extracted abilities can be used in the mission world.
Then there is nothing to say. Hua Twelve directly chose to withdraw the first reward, which was to withdraw the 240,000 U.S. dollars. However, it was useless for him to ask for the U.S. dollars, so he asked the system to directly convert it into RMB for him.
As soon as he chose to withdraw, the phone with a broken screen simultaneously sounded a text message alert. The message could barely be seen on the spider-like broken screen. The message showed that one million, five hundred and twenty-six thousand and forty dollars had been credited to his bank account.
"Yeah!"
Hua Twelve didn't think about whether the exchange rate was correct or anything, and waved his fist excitedly. Although Wang Li and his wife thanked him for the 500,000 yuan, he earned the more than 1.5 million yuan himself, so the feeling was naturally different.
The exciting moment came next. Hua Twelve took two deep breaths and planned to extract the grand prize, which was the power of the peak shark.
But just when he was about to withdraw the reward, the system sent a message:
"Since the extraction time for this reward is about twenty minutes, it is recommended that the host withdraw this reward in a safe environment!"
Hua Twelve was stunned: "Why does it take so long? Is there any danger?"
The system sent another message, and he instantly understood the reason.
It turns out that the problem lies with his body. With his current physical condition, he cannot bear the power of peak Shaq. Therefore, when extracting, his body will change accordingly to adapt to this powerful force.
Hua Twelve was startled and asked quickly: "You won't turn me into Shaq's shape, right?"
The system did not answer his question, as if he wanted it or not.
Hua Twelve thought about it for a long time. No matter what, let's leave the hospital first.
